description: Professor Analisa DiFeo conducts cancer research at the University of Michigan involving ovarian cancer, molecular biology, cancer genetics, cell biology, and translational medicine. The DiFeo Lab explicitly incorporates high-school mentorship into its training and community-outreach activities, with laboratory trainees serving as mentors to high-school students. Students have been recruited through organizations including the Young Scientist Foundation, which DiFeo co-founded to connect motivated high-school students with biomedical scientists and meaningful medical research experiences. The laboratory has documented recent high-school mentorship, providing strong evidence of continued engagement with pre-college researchers.

name: Elizabeth Proctor — Proctor Lab
title: Neuroscience, Proteomics and Biomedical Science Research Prospect
department: Department of Neurosurgery / Department of Pharmacology
description: Professor Elizabeth Proctor leads interdisciplinary biomedical research at Penn State College of Medicine involving neuroscience, proteomics, systems biology, protein biology, and mechanisms of neurological disease. The Proctor Lab's official personnel information documents multiple high-school students who have participated as research interns, providing direct precedent for pre-college research involvement. Penn State College of Medicine also maintains procedures allowing eligible high-school students to participate in research internships after identifying an appropriate faculty supervisor. Interested students should inquire regarding current laboratory projects, mentorship capacity, and institutional requirements.

name: Amelia Eisch — Eisch Lab
title: Neuroscience, Neurobiology and Pharmacology Research Prospect
university: University of Pennsylvania / Children's Hospital of Philadelphia
department: Department of Anesthesiology and Critical Care / Perelman School of Medicine
description: Professor Amelia Eisch conducts neuroscience and neurobiology research at the University of Pennsylvania and Children's Hospital of Philadelphia involving neurogenesis, brain development, behavioral neuroscience, pharmacology, psychiatric neuroscience, and related mechanisms of brain function and disease. Her official University of Pennsylvania faculty information documents extensive experience mentoring researchers at many educational levels, including 29 high-school students in her laboratory prior to her move to Penn and CHOP. This substantial mentorship history provides strong evidence of experience training pre-college researchers. Current high-school research availability should be verified directly with the laboratory and remains subject to Penn and CHOP research requirements.

name: Vijay Yechoor — Yechoor Lab
title: Metabolism, Diabetes and Endocrinology Research Prospect
description: Professor Vijay Yechoor leads biomedical research at the University of Pittsburgh involving metabolism, diabetes, endocrinology, glucose regulation, insulin resistance, physiology, and molecular mechanisms underlying metabolic disease. The Yechoor Lab's official personnel information includes high-school students among its former laboratory members, documenting multiple pre-college researchers who have participated in the research environment. This repeated precedent makes the laboratory a useful prospect for students interested in medicine, metabolism, molecular biology, or endocrinology. Current high-school research availability should be verified directly with the laboratory.

title: Mechanical Engineering, Fluid Mechanics and Turbulence Research Prospect
